system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Arcanist/Magic Scholar, Trainer, or Tactician/Strategist.

Use this skill when you put an Enemy in the [Identified] state. Give that enemy [Pursuit: (INT Mod)].

A special skill that allows you to see through the enemy's habits and weaknesses based on information. The accumulated knowledge and experience can sometimes become more powerful weapons than swords and magic.
